title_zh: Leisure time — 第37节可背诵讲义
body_en: Free time rests your mind. Read for pleasure, walk outside, or play a quiet game. Stop screens before sleep so you rest well. Plan free time like you plan study: short, regular, and enjoyable. Balanced days make stronger learners.
body_zh: 空闲时间让大脑休息。为乐趣阅读、到户外走走，或玩安静的游戏。睡前停下屏幕，才能休息好。像安排学习一样安排空闲：短、规律、愉快。平衡的日子造就更强的学习者。
